title: App container size inconsistent across device aspect ratios
description:
The app container appears squished (smaller width) on mobile phones compared to tablets. The dialog-style window sizing varies based on device aspect ratio, leading to inconsistent user experience.

**Current Behavior:**
- On tablets: Container appears at expected width
- On mobile phones: Container appears narrower/squished

**Expected Behavior:**
- Fixed container size across all device aspect ratios
- Consistent visual experience regardless of device form factor

**Technical Context:**
- App uses dialog-style window (see T9Activity.kt)
- Need to investigate WindowManager and layout constraints

comments.author: android
comments.text:
## Fix Applied

Changed themes.xml:12-13 from percentage to fixed dp:
- windowMinWidthMajor: 70% → 320dp
- windowMinWidthMinor: 70% → 320dp

This ensures consistent dialog width across all device aspect ratios.

title: Research Android WindowManager APIs for fixed dialog sizing
description:
Research how Android WindowManager handles dialog window dimensions and how to set fixed sizes that ignore device aspect ratio.

**Research Areas:**
- WindowManager.LayoutParams for dialog windows
- setLayout() with fixed dimensions vs percentage-based
- Display metrics and density-independent pixels (dp)
- Theme-based window sizing (windowMinWidthMajor/Minor)

comments.author: android
comments.text:
## Research Complete

**Solution: Use fixed dp values instead of percentages**

Replace percentage-based sizing with fixed dp:
- android:windowMinWidthMinor: 320dp
- android:windowMinWidthMajor: 320dp

Or use windowFixedWidth attributes for truly fixed sizing:
- android:windowFixedWidthMinor: 320dp
- android:windowFixedWidthMajor: 320dp

**Key insight**: windowMinWidthMinor = portrait mode, windowMinWidthMajor = landscape mode. Using the same dp value ensures consistency across all devices.

title: Research best practices for consistent dialog UI across form factors
description:
Research Android design guidelines and community best practices for maintaining consistent dialog dimensions across phones and tablets.

**Research Areas:**
- Material Design guidelines for dialogs
- Common patterns used by popular apps
- Responsive vs fixed sizing trade-offs
- Accessibility considerations for fixed sizes

comments.author: android
comments.text:
## Best Practices Research

**Material Design Recommendations:**
- Dialogs should have consistent, predictable sizing
- Fixed widths work well for launcher-style apps
- Common fixed widths: 280dp (compact), 320dp (medium), 360dp (comfortable)

**Recommended approach for T9 Dialer:**
- Use ~320dp fixed width (fits 3 app icons comfortably)
- Same value for both portrait and landscape
- Consider max width cap for very large screens

**Trade-offs:**
- Fixed size: Consistent UX but may waste space on tablets
- Percentage: Adaptive but inconsistent across devices
- Recommendation: Fixed is better for this apps compact UI goal

title: Analyze current T9Activity window configuration
description:
Analyze the current implementation in T9Activity.kt and related theme/style files to understand how window sizing is currently configured.

**Analysis Areas:**
- Current window flags and layout params
- Theme attributes affecting window size
- Layout XML constraints
- Identify specific code changes needed

comments.author: android
comments.text:
## Analysis Complete

**Root Cause Identified in themes.xml:12-13**

The dialog uses percentage-based sizing:
- windowMinWidthMajor: 70%
- windowMinWidthMinor: 70%

Minor axis (portrait/phones): 70% of narrow screen = squished
Major axis (landscape/tablets): 70% of wider screen = normal width

No programmatic sizing found in T9Activity.kt - window size is purely theme-driven.
